InQuest [[Princess Leia Organa]] insert (about 3.5×5) held next to the regular-size card. Still at 1:25 of ''Guide - SW:CCG Collection - Oversized/Undersized Cards''.

Fair use of a video still for identification of the physical magazine insert on [[Oversized and undersized cards|Oversized cards]].
